reason: A offers the more physically credible and decisive test: a defined annealing schedule can plausibly promote recovery and residual-stress relaxation, with matched as-built controls and direct stress and mechanical measurements. B is more novel but its oxides are well supported mainly for dispersion strengthening—not for reducing thermal gradients or residual stress—and its added preheating, vague oxide loading, and inconsistent baseline confound the claimed single intervention.
